Compute statistical orbit data

Source: R/directional-cylindrical.R
stat_orbit_data.Rd

Computes local conditional means, local standard deviations and local skewness over an angular grid.

Usage

stat_orbit_data(theta, x, n_theta = 181, kappa = 20)

Arguments

theta

Angles in radians.

x

Real-valued response.

n_theta

Number of angular grid points.

kappa

Circular concentration for local weighting.

Value

A data frame with theta, mu, lower, upper and skew.

See also

Other cylindrical dependence helpers: circular_topography_data(), estimate_cyl_density(), phase_loom_data()

Examples

dat <- simulate_cylindrical(n = 80, seed = 1)
stat_orbit_data(dat$theta, dat$x, n_theta = 24)
